checks.name: logo_rule_pal
checks._comment: Solid white rule at band row 13 (raster lines 155-162). matCell(k,13*40+c) returns code 0 (font all-$FF) for the LOGO_W columns under the word; colour RAM white at those positions. This reads a known matrix cell value (code 0) through the custom font: if either the matrix content or font is wrong, white pixels are absent. Phase-independent width: since 2026-09-24 the word is C64-KB, 23 cells wide at column 7 of matrix 0, so the rule starts at vic_x 24 + 7*8 = 80 and is 184 pixels long; the wobble shifts each band line right by 1 to 55 pixels (the sine is clamped to 1..55, k_max 6), so the rule occupies 80+s to 264+s for s in 1..55, and the pixels white at every phase run from 135 to 264. This rect covers 136 to 263 of them. The MEASURED word (31 cells at column 3) had its rule at 48 to 296 plus the shift, and this rect was 112 wide 176 for it.

checks.name: plasma_above_not_black
checks._comment: Rows 0-7 (lines 51-114), the plasma above the logo: at least 4,000 of the 20,480 pixels are not black. Before 2026-09-24 these rows were blank on black; the plasma paints their colour RAM every fourth frame, so a build whose main never runs the plasma, or whose matrix rows are not code 0, leaves them black and fails here.

checks.name: plasma_above_not_white
checks._comment: The same rows are not all white either: setup fills colour RAM white, so a plasma whose repaint never happened shows 320 by 64 solid white and fails here. Together with the check above: the rows are neither all black nor all white. The ramp's top bucket (white) is never reached by design, so most of the region is not white.
